skill.name: verify-output
skill.description: Guides agents to validate structured JSON outputs against required schemas before writing final files.
skill.summary: Validate structured agent outputs before publishing them to workflow files.
skill.author: Clouder0

security_audit.summary: All static findings appear to be false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline code formatting, and schema validation language. I found no evidence of malicious command execution, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, network access, or credential handling in SKILL.md.

| `Additional properties not allowed` | Remove extra fields |

content.value_statement: Structured AI outputs can fail downstream workflows when required fields are missing. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through schema validation before publishing.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when to validate final structured output.
Maps role-based schemas to expected output paths.
Shows a temporary-file validation workflow before final writes.
Lists fixes for missing fields, invalid enums, and wrong types.
Defines mandatory knowledge update and reflection fields.
Recommends compact JSON output for downstream executors.
limitations: Requires validation scripts and schema files in the target repository.
Does not provide the actual schema definitions.
Does not validate output automatically without Bash access or an external runner.
Focuses on JSON outputs for the referenced agent workflow.

use_cases.title: Check Task Deliverables
use_cases.description: Validate task output before replacing the final workflow file.

use_cases.title: Review Verification Reports
use_cases.description: Confirm verification output includes required fields before handoff.

use_cases.title: Standardize Agent Records
use_cases.description: Keep reports, reflections, and contract files aligned with shared schemas.

prompt_templates.title: Validate One Output
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before writing a final file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the verify-output pattern on this task result. Check the required schema, fix validation errors, and tell me when it is ready.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Schema Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these validation errors against the expected output schema. Update the structured result and explain the corrected fields.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Final Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow handoff with temporary output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the output in a temporary location, validate it against the correct role schema, then finalize it only after validation passes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Output Discipline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a multi-agent workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this workflow for output validation gaps. Identify which roles need schema checks and propose a consistent verification process.

output_examples.input: A task output is ready but has not been checked against its schema.
output_examples.output: The assistant writes a temporary output, runs validation, fixes reported schema errors, and then publishes the final file.

output_examples.input: Validation reports that a required field is missing.
output_examples.output: The assistant adds the missing field, reruns validation, and reports failure only after bounded retries.

output_examples.input: An agent needs compact structured output for an executor.
output_examples.output: The assistant keeps required fields present and removes formatting whitespace before final validation.

best_practices: Validate temporary files before replacing final outputs.
Keep required fields present, even when values are empty arrays.
Review validation errors and fix the output object before retrying.
anti_patterns: Publishing structured output before validation passes.
Ignoring enum and type errors from the schema validator.
Using this skill when no schema or validation command exists.

faq.question: What does this skill verify?
faq.answer: It verifies that structured agent outputs match the required schema before final write.

faq.question: Does it include schema files?
faq.answer: No. It expects the repository to provide schema files and a validation script.

faq.question: Can it validate non-JSON outputs?
faq.answer: The documented workflow focuses on JSON outputs and compact JSON formatting.

faq.question: Why write to a temporary file first?
faq.answer: Temporary files prevent invalid output from replacing a final workflow artifact.

faq.question: Does it require Bash access?
faq.answer: Yes, the documented validation flow uses Bash examples for local validation commands.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for agents and maintainers who produce schema-bound workflow files.
